name: Simi Khalid
intro: Paintings of landscape, Islamic architecture and calligraphy.
bio:
Simi Khalid is a painter based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Her work moves between three subjects: the landscapes of the region, mosques and Islamic architecture, and Arabic calligraphy.

Every painting shown here is an original. If one speaks to you, send a message — she is always happy to talk about the work.
